title: Before you begin
body: The Void is a game about a condition that takes a person apart, and about whether anything is left afterwards. You play it as a descent — five floors down, and a way back up if you earn one.

It was written out of lived experience rather than research. That is why the game never names the thing it is about and never puts a number on it. You are meant to feel it and be unable to point at it.

It is a survivor's story, and that is built into the structure rather than offered as consolation. Something real and good is waiting further down. The best ending is being made whole, and it is reachable.
If you are in the worst of it right now, this may not be the week to play it. That is not a judgement about you. The game will keep. Close it, come back whenever you want, and begin again.
